messages:
mike_sales: Hey team — MercuryPay POC reached final order form. Two blockers: CFO insists on wet-ink for countersign (internal audit), and Procurement wants KMS/HSM proof for the DPA. Any quick options?

devon_se: Wait — do they require a physical wet-ink for both parties or just their CFO? :thinking: 

mike_sales: just their CFO wants the original. Legal already cleared e-sign for MSA but finance flagged their audit policy.

ekaterina_procurement: They also added a clause requiring proof that keys are HSM-backed and a vendor/subprocessor list. They want SOC2 artifact + KMS provider name.

anne_legal: I reviewed the redlines. We can usually accept an attestation + artifact instead of wet-ink for a POC. Proposal: provide an HSM attestation PDF + a signed addendum that limits audit scope to POC and requires 30d notice. That should satisfy the DPA ask while preserving our risk profile.

carla_finance: Net terms issue — MercuryPay asked for net-60 on POC. Finance can provisionally allow net-60 for up to $10k if we receive a PO with billing contact and either prepaid card or a credit hold.

mike_sales: I can ask them. On e-sign routing: docsign-bot attempted to send envelope to their CFO but failed with `external_signer_domain_unverified`.

docsign-bot: envelope 0x7f4 created, status: failed. reason: external_signer_domain_unverified. See https://redwood.docs/esign/errors for remediation steps.

devon_se: If domain verification is the blocker, options are: (1) route to exec signer + courier for wet-ink, or (2) use DocuSign Notary (notarized e-sign). Notary preserves e-sign flow but adds a notary attestation. Which does legal prefer?

anne_legal: Notary looks promising. We need to confirm the notarization meets their internal compliance definition. If we provide HSM attestation + limited-audit addendum + notarized e-sign for their CFO, that combination should close the legal and procurement asks.

ekaterina_procurement: Action list: mike -> confirm customer can issue a PO with net-60 + billing contact; mike -> ask CFO if notarized e-sign is acceptable instead of wet-ink. devon -> prepare HSM attestation artifact (`hsm_attest_v1.pdf`) and link to KMS docs. anne -> draft the concise addendum limiting audit scope.

mike_sales: @carla_finance can you pre-approve net-60 for POC contingent on PO + $10k cap?

carla_finance: +1 contingent approval. Send PO to billing@redwood.com and cc finance-ops.

mike_sales: Update from MercuryPay: CFO says notarized e-sign is okay if it's an actual notary (not just standard e-sign). They could do courier if needed but would prefer notarized workflow to avoid delays.

devon_se: I'll stand up a DocuSign Notary flow and add their CFO as the external notary signer. Also adding the KMS proof here: https://redwood.docs/kms/hsm-proof and artifact name `hsm_attest_v1.pdf` (will attach).

anne_legal: Draft addendum looks good; I'll incorporate the notary language and then route to our Exec for signature once the envelope is ready. Keep it narrow: POC only, 30-day audit notice, scope-limited.

docsign-bot: envelope 0x7f5 created, status: sent to external notary. tracking id: DN-22478.

mike_sales: Great — I'll send the PO + signature instructions to MercuryPay and confirm courier fallback only if notarized e-sign fails. Thanks everyone. Closing when signed. :thumbsup:
